stories.title: Can Trump deport Ilhan Omar?
stories.take: The answer: No — denaturalization over paperwork discrepancies is very uncommon and unlikely to succeed, and canceling her citizenship certificate would not strip citizenship, only the document proving it • Federal agents searched Omar's DC home over alleged birthdate and military-service misstatements on her father's naturalization paperwork • David Graham calls it Trump's playbook: declare guilt publicly, claim DOJ independence, lose in court • Obama broke silence to condemn the targeting as violating a basic principle of American democracy

stories.title: How AI Is Changing What Work Means
stories.take: The answer: AI now lets non-experts do specialized work outside their field — Citrini Research used Claude and 300 subagents to design 318,000 scorpion anti-venom protein candidates in days for under $200K, with 17 confirmed binders • The bottleneck moved to the physical world: 64 hours of AI design vs. 39 days for lab results vs. 4–7 years to release • Anthropic's leaked financials show an $8.7B operating loss and $750B in compute commitments • OpenAI bought Orchestra Bio and Anthropic quietly built a wet lab — labs are becoming science companies, not just model providers

stories.title: How we really feel about the iPhone Duo | Livestream
stories.take: The verdict: 'It's a really fun thing to play with. You should wait.' — none of the three hosts bought the $2,000 foldable • Impressive hinge and matte inner screen, but the outer screen is too small, battery life collapses when used open, and most apps are unoptimized 'vibe-coded' stretches • No telephoto camera and no Face ID; quality lands near iPhone 14/15 generation • Better buy per the hosts: an iPhone 16 Pro plus an iPad Mini for substantially less

stories.title: Texas: Democrats' eternal hope
stories.take: Both Texas races sit within a few points — Abbott vs. Hosa for governor and Paxton vs. Talarico for Senate, in a state Democrats haven't won statewide since 1994 • Talarico has led nearly every poll, running on corruption against Paxton's impeachment and fraud baggage; billboards call him 'the most corrupt politician in America' • Over $500M in TV ads since the primaries, and Trump's Texas approval is 46% • The hosts' caution: it's 'Lucy and the football' — midterm turnout drops (young voters 43% to 21%) decide whether hope survives

stories.title: Witkoff praises Putin as 'a humanitarian'

stories.take: Both boards formed special committees to study a merger Musk calls a 'super intelligence singularity' play — sources say it reads as 'when, not if,' but Tesla shareholders must approve • SpaceX beat estimates on Starlink and AI compute leasing • Netflix missed: revenue light, ad guidance cut ~10%, stock down ~5% and ~30% YTD, with a content leadership shake-up • United passed 72% of soaring fuel costs to fares, and the FAA certified Boeing's 737 MAX-10 with ~2,000 orders in backlog
